guard: The effect ceiling is a RUN bound recovered from the journal at every activation, and the step budget is deliberately not: it bounds one walk and its message says so. (This suite is FAIL-FAST: it throws at the first failed check, so no line prints unconditionally at the end. Each mutation therefore names a marker printed just UPSTREAM of the region it breaks — a marker downstream of the mutation would be absent on every genuine kill.)

mutations.name: every activation starts with a fresh allowance again
mutations.find: this.effects = { journal: this.journal, options, ceiling: pins.effectCeiling, effectCount: this.journal.dispatchedEffects() };
mutations.replace: this.effects = { journal: this.journal, options, ceiling: pins.effectCeiling, effectCount: 0 };
mutations.expectRed: the resumed run reaches the ceiling the RUN was pinned to, not a fresh one
mutations.completionMarker: and stays well inside one yield interval (1024)
mutations.cell: the resumed run reaches the ceiling the RUN was pinned to, not a fresh one

mutations.name: the recovered count double-counts, so the ceiling arrives early
mutations.expectRed: and it stops at the pinned number rather than after it
mutations.completionMarker: and stays well inside one yield interval (1024)
mutations.cell: and it stops at the pinned number rather than after it

mutations.name: the step budget's message drops the clause that says it is not the run
mutations.find: (stepBudget bounds ONE WALK, not the run: steps are not recorded, so a resume cannot recover a count the way the effect ceiling can.)
mutations.expectRed: and its message says it bounds ONE WALK, not the run
mutations.completionMarker: the message quotes the pinned ceiling
mutations.cell: and its message says it bounds ONE WALK, not the run
